Goal: make sure the listing will pass validation and the SI knows how to run the hands-on labs.

- Fri Aug 27, 09:00–10:30 (SI breakout rehearsal — 2 parallel rooms)

CloudWave Inc.

- We'll use the attached runbook (v3) as the baseline. Please review section 4 (artifact uploads) and confirm you have your service account keys ready.
